title: General.
officialText:
Gas equipment installed in existing unlisted boilers shall comply with Section 631.1 and shall be installed in
accordance with the manufacturer’s instructions and the New York City Mechanical Code.
SECTION FGC 633
FUEL CELL POWER PLANTS
